doc.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Never doing New York studio work
summary: He missed the jingle and studio scene and its high pay and pensions.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: What about studio work over the years? Did you ever play jingles or get into any of that studio scene?
No. Didn’t get into that. That sure is the big time scene in New York.
Some guys tell me, wow, ten thousand I made. And some guys are getting pensions as high as four thousand dollars a month. You see I wasn’t hip to that.
Yeah they were doing three sessions a day sometimes.
